source: clinical isolates from patient specimens (type not specified) plus proficiency-sample isolates

source: nail samples from adults with onychomycosis

evidence: "Se realizó la prueba de sensibilidad antifúngica a 55 dermatofitos, 43 levaduras..."; "fluconazol 11,7 µg/ml, itraconazol 0,93 µg/ml y terbinafina 0,39 µg/ml, considerándose estas concentraciones como punto de corte"; "tropicalis (7 de 13 aislamientos)".
notes: Species identification method not described in Methods. Cut-offs are non-standard (nail tissue levels).

source: oral mucosa of children (1-5 years) at a public day-care centre
identification_method: germ tube test, zymogram (sugar fermentation) and auxanogram (sugar assimilation)
evidence: "identificadas por testes micológicos. Verificou-se que 67 (18%) apresentaram leveduras do gênero Candida. A Candida albicans foi a mais frequente, com 30 isolados (45%), seguida pelas C. tropicalis (31%)".
notes: Abstract implies ~21 C. tropicalis (31% of 67) from oral colonisation (C1), but the percentages do not sum exactly to 67; enzymatic tests only for C. albicans; no AST. Full text font-encoded with digits lost; check PDF results table. Likely INCLUDE (IC3) if count confirmed.

source: invasive clinical isolates (bloodstream, pneumonia, SSSI, IAI, UTI, other) from 66 hospitals
